content: Kiara Sen contacted Vikram Patel regarding her health insurance policy renewal (SH-123456). She confirmed submission of the renewal form and payment of the premium. Vikram encountered system issues where the policy was incorrectly displaying as 'expired' despite the payment. He promised to escalate the issue to ensure coverage remains active and committed to follow up with Kiara by the end of the day to confirm the records are updated.

action_items: Escalate system issue regarding policy status to resolve expired record
Follow up with customer by end of day to confirm records are updated
